caption_L1: Average viewers of Call of Duty : Warzone on Twitch worldwide from September 2019 to December 2020 (in 1000s) is a area diagram. The x-axis plots Month. A linear scale from 0 to 120 can be found on the y-axis, labeled Number of viewers in thousands.
caption_L2L3: The number of viewers increased from zero in July 2019 to nearly 40,000 by November 2019.  This then declined to just over 10,000 in January 2020.  In February 2020, viewers increased rapidly to 120,000.  Since February 2020, numbers have decreased, but have not fallen below 70,000 at any point.
